title: [Feature Request]: introduce 'verbosity' param into llmconfig
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

[1.1 Overview](https://cookbook.openai.com/examples/gpt-5/gpt-5_new_params_and_tools#11-overview)
The verbosity parameter lets you hint to the model to be more or less expansive in its replies.

Values: "low", "medium", "high"

low → terse UX, minimal prose.
medium (default) → balanced detail.
high → verbose, great for audits, teaching, or hand-offs.
Keep prompts stable and use the param rather than rewriting.

### Describe the solution you'd like
